diagram_math_checks.relation: The horizontal highlighted interval has endpoints x-c(t-s) and x+c(t-s).

diagram_math_checks.relation: The entire region contributes (1/(2c)) times the integral of f(y,s), and at t=0 it collapses to (x,0).
diagram_math_checks.justification: The caption repeats the coefficient and source density from the unchanged Statement and step 4.1. At t=0, the bounds force s=0 and y=x. The drawing is expressly for t>0.
